name: raha
description: Raha — Ethiopian freight marketplace. Matches cargo with truck capacity already on the road, including return loads.

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @raha/api && npm run build -w @raha/web && npm run build -w @raha/ops
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @raha/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @raha/api && npm run typecheck -w @raha/web && npm run typecheck -w @raha/ops
